description: Binary assertions for /helix-task-clarify v3.1 multi-agent pipeline orchestration
test_input: task clarification for VN-USV-SS-001 low-observable maritime autonomous surface vessel

assertions.name: pipeline_orchestration
assertions.check: output follows pipeline structure with CEO checkpoints

assertions.name: block_preflight
assertions.check: output includes preflight with stakeholder register and standards scan

assertions.name: block_requirements_16cat
assertions.check: output generates requirements using 16 P&B categories

assertions.name: block_validate_dw
assertions.check: output includes D/W classification (human judgment, not AI)

assertions.name: block_abstraction
assertions.check: output includes 5-step abstraction and essential problem

assertions.name: block_structure
assertions.check: output produces function structure with verb+noun format

assertions.name: block_compile
assertions.check: output compiles deliverables and references Gate 1

assertions.name: ifr_sacred_constraints
assertions.check: output includes IFR statement and sacred constraints

assertions.name: tvdt_present
assertions.check: output includes TVDT for top requirements

assertions.name: failure_derived
assertions.check: output includes failure-derived requirements or SPOF check
